### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Unit catch-up amount, authorization `ac711229…`, due date 2026-09-15.**
- Baseline (unit_catchup_amount): 389.00 × 0.90 = 350.10 (Premier Climate Suite 10%).
- In-flight (unit_catchup_in_flight_drafts): latest draft date 10-13, due 10-15 > 09-15, result empty; no lien notice fee for 09-15 → subtract 350.10.
- Late fee counted (unit_catchup_late_fee_figure): flat 30.00, max 75.00, 10% × 389.00 = 38.90 → 38.90.
- Returned-period late fees (unit_returned_period_late_fees): second late fee posted for 09-15 → 38.90 + 25.00 = 63.90.
- Courtesy waiver (unit_catchup_courtesy_waiver): latest waiver (10-06) references the 09-15 second late fee → leave out 25.00.
- Lien-process fees (unit_catchup_lien_process_fees): overlock fee posted for 09-15, no lien notice fee → 30.00.
- Returned-payment fees (unit_catchup_returned_payment_fees): 2 settled attempts for 09-15 → 35.00 × 2 = 70.00.

**(b) Unit notice amount, authorization `ac711229…`, due date 2026-11-15 (scored target).**

- Projected late fees (unit_projected_late_fees): 10% × 406.50 = 40.65 (above 30.00, not above 75.00) + second late fee 25.00 = 65.65.
- Projected lien fees (unit_projected_lien_fees): rent of 10-15 left unpaid and no past-due carried → overlock 30.00 (lien-notice tier needs a carried past-due balance).
